name: Koufuku no Katachi
source:
The main hero discovers a strange long rabbit ears girl who got hurt in an accident. The girl does not understand human language, but is of cheerful personality. As their cohabitation begins, it gets known that the girl is the last descendant of the tribe that can make any wish come true.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-october-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公发现一名长着奇特兔耳、因事故受伤的女孩。她不懂人类的语言，性格却十分开朗。两人开始共同生活后，主人公得知她是一个能够实现任何愿望的种族最后的后裔。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-october-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
